title: Strawberry Popsicles
summary: These homemade Strawberry Popsicles with just 4 ingredients are fun to make, easy to prepare, and delicious to eat!
ingredients: 1 pound fresh ripe strawberries, hulled and sliced
steps: Add all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into your mold. Freeze for at least six hours, preferably overnight.
